verification: CI fixture HTTP through the FastAPI test client; tokens, grants and requests are fixture-local, not production.

state.observed: All ten pull request checks pass on the tested commit.
state.accepted: Sixteen new brain-api fixture cases pass in the full brain-api suite on three Python versions.
state.externally_verified: None; no deployed brain was exercised. G6 rollout must validate deployed behavior.

rollback.rehearsal: Fixture disables the route, reads the project feed, re-enables and compares the operation id unchanged.
rollback.data_safety: The route writes no authoritative state; the replay cache and revision guard are process memory and safe to drop.

limitations: Launch binding is not validated: execution_id is accepted as supplied and is not tied to the credential; the kernel holds no launch-binding credential yet.
A worker token without a #lane suffix may act as any lane, matching the open-by-default project grant; deployed KB_WORKER_TOKENS must carry lane suffixes. Tests exercise eng and ci only.

The stale revision guard and replay cache are per process: a restart, a second worker process, or LRU eviction past BRAIN_CONTEXT_ACCEPTED_KEPT (10000) tasks lets an older task revision be accepted again.
No retrieval, ranking, packing, caching or receipts: those are SV2-CTX-02 to SV2-CTX-05. The response is the accepted request with its operation identity.
